aggregate_trade_events.meaning: Number of rows in the Binance `aggTrades` archive. Each row represents trades from a single taker order that filled at the SAME price and within the SAME timestamp unit.

underlying_execution_matches.meaning: Number of individual matching-engine trade executions (`trade_id`s) compressed into an `aggTrade` row at the same price and timestamp. Each match pairs the aggressor order against a resting maker slice at that single price level.

unique_resting_orders.meaning: True count of distinct resting limit orders on the book. Cannot be equated to `last_trade_id - first_trade_id + 1` when one maker order is hit across multiple aggTrades or when self-trade prevention / iceberg replenishment splits executions.

multi_price_level_sweeps.formula: count(consecutive aggTrades with ts_k == ts_{k-1}, sign_k == sign_{k-1}, and price_k != price_{k-1})
multi_price_level_sweeps.meaning: A single aggressive market order walking across multiple distinct price levels on the order book. Because Binance `aggTrades` splits whenever price changes, a multi-price-level sweep produces MULTIPLE `aggTrade` rows at the identical timestamp with monotonic price progression, whereas `last_id - first_id + 1 >= 3` within a single `aggTrade` row measures multi-match fragmentation at a SINGLE price level.

basis_decomposition_summary.classification: HYBRID_COMMON_QUOTE_BASIS_PLUS_GENUINE_CROSS_VENUE_RESIDUAL: Cross-sectional IC is mathematically invariant to a common multiplicative USDT-USD factor at timestamp t, while time-series IC retains >88% of its strength after exact USDT-USD quote normalization.

historical_l1_l2_probes.label: Coinbase Exchange Historical Order Book Archive Endpoint (Non-existent on REST)

checklist_evaluation.signal_availability: 1h and 5m candle closes are available at bar close T + network propagation latency (~50-250ms), but historical L1 bid/ask quotes at exact timestamp T are NOT archived for Binance Spot or Coinbase Spot.
checklist_evaluation.decision_to_order_latency: Cross-venue REST/WebSocket ingestion + feature computation + Spot order routing requires ~100-500ms in live production. In historical 5m/1h data, any delay pushes execution from bar T close to bar T+1 open or mid-bar.
checklist_evaluation.earliest_permissible_executable_quote: UNOBSERVED_HISTORICALLY: Neither Binance Spot (`bookTicker`/`bookDepth` HTTP 404) nor Coinbase Exchange provides free historical L1 best-bid/best-ask quotes at bar close T.
checklist_evaluation.available_order_book_liquidity: UNOBSERVED_HISTORICALLY_ON_SPOT: Historical `bookDepth` archives exist on `data.binance.vision` ONLY for USD-M Futures (`data/futures/um/daily/bookDepth`), NOT for Binance Spot (`HTTP 404`) or Coinbase Spot.
checklist_evaluation.partial_fills_and_adverse_selection: Passive limit orders (Maker) on Binance Spot during a Coinbase price jump suffer severe adverse selection (filled only when the Coinbase lead reverses, missed when price continues). Market/IOC orders (Taker) guarantee fill up to top-of-book depth but pay full Taker fee + half-spread + price impact.
